notes: Lot-rent and cap-rate assumptions for estimated values. Prefer facts stated on the subject listing. Area lot rents use on-market Crexi comps first, then published city comps, then the RealMobileHomes 2026 state average. Market caps use the median listed cap of on-market MHPs in the same state and 3-mile-pop tier when at least two comps exist; otherwise the rural 10.5% / secondary 9% / metro 7.5% tier default, plus +1% if POH share >50% and +0.5% if well/septic. Assumptions are labeled and must not be presented as listing facts.

defaults.occupancy_note: Assume 85% occupancy when the listing does not state occupancy or an occupied-unit count.
defaults.tier_note: Rural = 3-mi pop under 5,000 (10.5%). Secondary = 5,000–50,000 (9%). Metro = over 50,000 (7.5%).
defaults.overall_ppl_note: Last-resort pad count = ask ÷ $75,781 overall median price/pad when pads and unit counts are both unknown.
